problem_results.title: Live run status updates without a manual refresh
problem_results.steps:
1. Start a run in one tab
2. Watch a second tab
problem_results.expected_result: Second tab updates live as results come in
problem_results.notes: Second tab's WebSocket connection silently dropped - no update received

problem_results.title: Client resyncs state after reconnect
problem_results.steps:
1. Disconnect network briefly during a run
2. Reconnect
problem_results.expected_result: Client catches up to the current run state
problem_results.notes: Client stayed on stale data after reconnecting

problem_results.title: Progress bar reflects final run state
problem_results.steps: 1. Let the run finish

problem_results.title: Generate test cases with no API key configured
problem_results.steps:
1. Remove the AI API key
2. Call the generate endpoint
problem_results.notes: Server returned a 500 with a Python traceback in the response body

problem_results.title: Generate test cases with a malformed model response
problem_results.steps:
1. Mock the model to return non-JSON text
2. Call the generate endpoint
problem_results.expected_result: 502 response with a clear error message
problem_results.notes: Endpoint hung until the request timed out

problem_results.title: Run stats update shortly after the run completes
problem_results.steps:
1. Complete a run
2. Check the project stats endpoint
problem_results.expected_result: Stats reflect the completed run within a few seconds
problem_results.notes: Stats were still showing the previous run's numbers after two minutes

problem_results.title: Redelivered event does not double-count a run
problem_results.steps: 1. Force the consumer to redeliver a processed message
problem_results.expected_result: Stats are unchanged by the redelivery
problem_results.notes: Pass count was incremented a second time for the same run

problem_results.title: Two admins rename the same suite at once
problem_results.steps:
1. Admin A and Admin B both open the rename dialog
2. Both submit different names within a second of each other
problem_results.expected_result: One rename wins cleanly, or a conflict is surfaced
problem_results.notes: Suite ended up with a name matching neither submission

problem_results.title: Deleted-by-another-admin suite is handled gracefully
problem_results.steps:
1. Admin A deletes a suite
2. Admin B (who still has it open) tries to edit it
problem_results.expected_result: Admin B sees a 'no longer exists' message
problem_results.notes: Admin B's edit succeeded and recreated a suite with the old ID reused

problem_results.title: Fourth rapid contact-form submission is rejected
problem_results.steps:
1. Submit the contact form three times quickly
2. Submit a fourth time
problem_results.expected_result: 429 Too Many Requests on the fourth attempt
problem_results.notes: All four submissions were accepted - no rate limit was applied

problem_results.title: Rate limit resets after the cooldown window
problem_results.steps:
1. Trigger the rate limit
2. Wait for the cooldown window
3. Submit again
problem_results.notes: Still returns 429 well after the documented cooldown window has passed

problem_results.title: Creating a suite with a duplicate name in the same project
problem_results.steps:
1. Create a suite named 'Smoke Tests'
2. Create another suite named 'Smoke Tests' in the same project
problem_results.expected_result: A clear validation error naming the conflict
problem_results.notes: Server returned a raw database constraint-violation error

problem_results.title: [FAIL] appears literally in a prior report's notes field
problem_results.steps:
1. Re-run a previously failed test
2. Copy its old notes forward
problem_results.notes: Notes field still contains the literal text '[FAIL]' copied from the prior run, and the test is failing again with a different root cause this time: a rendering exception, not the original issue

problem_results.title: [SKIP] marker in an unrelated test's notes
problem_results.steps: 1. Run the suite
problem_results.notes: Notes mention a neighboring test was marked '[SKIP]' for an unrelated reason; this test itself is failing on a null pointer in the results renderer
